en: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. By Asaph.

zh: 亞薩的詩，交與伶長。用迦特樂器。

p.src: 1  Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!

en: Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!
u.src: 1  Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!

p.src: 2  Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.

en: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
u.src: 2  Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.

p.src: 3  Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.

en: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.
u.src: 3  Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.

p.src: 4  For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

en: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
u.src: 4  For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

p.src: 5  He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.

en: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.
u.src: 5  He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.

p.src: 6  “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.

en: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.
u.src: 6  “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.

p.src: 7  You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.

en: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.
u.src: 7  You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.

p.src: 8  “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!

en: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!
u.src: 8  “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!

p.src: 9  There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.

en: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.
u.src: 9  There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.

p.src: 10  I am the LORD, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

en: I am the LORD, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
u.src: 10  I am the LORD, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

p.src: 11  But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.

en: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
u.src: 11  But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.

p.src: 12  So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

en: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.
u.src: 12  So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

p.src: 13  Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!

en: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
u.src: 13  Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!

p.src: 14  I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

en: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.
u.src: 14  I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

p.src: 15  The haters of the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

en: The haters of the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.
u.src: 15  The haters of the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

p.src: 16  But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”

en: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
u.src: 16  But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
